title: Fortinet security advisory (AV26-1081)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1081 Date: October 23, 2026 As of October 21, 2026, Fortinet is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: FortiAnalyzer 8.0 Versions prior to 8.0.2 FortiAnalyzer 7.6 Versions prior to 7.6.8 FortiAnalyzer 7.4 Versions prior to 7.4.12 FortiAnalyzer 7.2 Versions prior to 7.2.13 FortiAuthenticator 8.0 Versions prior to 8.0.4 FortiAuthenticator 6.6 Versions prior to 6.6.11 FortiMail 8.0 Versions prior to 8.0.2 FortiMail 7.6 Versions prior to 7.6.7 FortiMail 7.4 Versions prior to 7.4.9 FortiMail 7.2 Upgrade to branch 7.4 or above FortiManager 8.0 Versions prior to 8.0.2 FortiManager 7.6 Versions prior to 7.6.8 FortiManager 7.4 Versions prior to 7.4.12 FortiManager 7.2 Versions prior to 7.2.13 FortiOS 8.0 Versions prior to 8.0.2 FortiOS 7.6 Versions prior to 7.6.8 FortiOS 7.4 Versions prior to 7.4.13 FortiOS 7.2 Versions prior to 7.2.14 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Fortinet Releases Security Hardening Release for Multiple Products Fortinet PSIRT Advisories Article Link: Fortinet security advisory (AV26-1081) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
